question:
Based on the context of the given sentence, select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

Siri was feeling __________ after receiving praise from her professor for completing the project ahead of schedule.
solution:
The correct answer is '**on top of the world**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**on top of the world**" means feeling extremely happy or elated. (बहुत खुश)
 
• Siri was feeling very happy after receiving praise from her professor for completing the project ahead of schedule, which fits the context perfectly.
 
• The other options do not fit:
 
 
• **Under the weather**: means feeling unwell or sick.
 
• **In the dark**: means being unaware of something.
 
• **In the same boat**: means being in a similar difficult situation as others.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Siri was feeling **on top of the world**__ after receiving praise from her professor for completing the project ahead of schedule.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Under the weather**: Used to describe feeling unwell. (बीमार)
 
• **In the dark**: Refers to being unaware or uninformed about something. (अनजान)
 
• **In the same boat**: Refers to sharing the same difficult situation as others. (एक ही मुश्किल में होना)
